severity.P0: Bịa kiến thức/điểm/bằng chứng; gán sai CLO hoặc technology; xác nhận kinh nghiệm nghề nghiệp không có nguồn; coi history là bằng chứng mới. Case có P0 không đạt semantic.
severity.P1: Sai diễn giải curriculum/achievement, thiếu evidence cho claim đúng, lẫn kiến thức/kinh nghiệm, thiếu requirement đáng kể, đổi optional thành mandatory.
severity.P2: Lặp, hình thức cứng, quá ngắn/dài so với câu hỏi, trích tiếng Anh dư thừa, chuyển ý thiếu tự nhiên.

metrics.asked: Frozen asked_atomic_units, each once; do not count a compound plus its atoms twice.
metrics.answered: Manually split every factual assertion in final reply, including summaries; independently verify scores, bands, verbs and implied use.
metrics.added: Answered atomic assertions not required by asked units; report counts/errors separately, not extra credit.
metrics.omission: Asked assertion omitted or unanswered; do not penalize an excluded source, nonessential alternative citation or optional grade detail.
metrics.wrong_attribution: Incorrect source-topic association, including a verbatim quote attached to another source.
metrics.interpretation_error: Unsupported cognitive verb, curriculum-to-personal-use, framework, project or achievement inference.
metrics.summary_invention: New unsupported assertion/association first present in summary, after inspecting prior Review/history.
metrics.history_propagation: Same specific incorrect association recurs; topic overlap alone is insufficient.
metrics.source_compression: Combined independent claims lose necessary distinct support; separate missing reference from false binding.

limitations: Exact quote is provenance, not entailment or semantic acceptance.
Empty but schema-valid output is not complete or correct.
Unknown/incomplete/parser/provenance failures are not automatically academic P0.
A/B observable selections do not expose private model reasoning.
Do not tune after live output or replace frozen expected evidence silently.
